questions.stem: What is the main idea?
questions.explanation: The answer is “Friends get ready quickly to attend a puppet show.”. Evidence: We hear about a free puppet show from our school noticeboard. It is in the library, and the first performance begins after lunch. Lily wants a seat near the front so she can see the small puppets. When we finish eating, she asks us to hurry up. We put away our lunch boxes promptly and walk to the library together. There are still several empty seats near the stage when we arrive. We sit down quietly and wait for the storyteller to open the curtain.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“Friends get ready quickly to attend a puppet show.”。原文依据：我们从学校公告栏上听说有一场免费木偶表演。地点在图书馆，第一场表演午饭后开始。莉莉想坐前排，好看清小木偶。吃完饭后，她请我们赶快。我们马上收好饭盒，一起走向图书馆。我们到达时，舞台旁还有几个空座位。我们安静地坐下，等讲故事的人拉开幕布。

questions.stem: Which title is best?
questions.explanation: The answer is “A Patient Phone Call Finds the Needed Book”. Evidence: I telephone the library to ask about a book for our project. The librarian asks me to hold on while she checks the shelf. I keep the phone beside my ear and wait quietly. She returns and says the book is missing from its usual place. She checks the returns desk and finds it under another large book. In the end, she says I can collect it that afternoon. I thank her for looking carefully and tell my group that our plan can continue.
questions.parentExplanation: 正确项为“A Patient Phone Call Finds the Needed Book”。原文依据：我打电话给图书馆，询问我们课题需要的一本书。图书管理员请我别挂断，她去检查书架。我把电话放在耳边，安静地等着。她回来后说，书不在平常的位置。她检查还书台，在另一本大书下面找到了它。最后，她说我那天下午就能来取。我感谢她仔细查找，并告诉小组成员，我们的计划可以继续了。
